text: This report seeks the approval of the Board of Directors of Toronto Parking Authority (TPA) to award a contract for the implementation of new inbuilding Distributed Antenna System (DAS) cell phone repeater systems at the following eight (8) car parks: Car Park 13: 20 Delisle Avenue Car Park 36: 110 Queen Street West Car Park 42: 91 Via Italia Car Park 49: 30 Roehampton Car Park 52: 40 York Street Car Park 58: 9 Bedford Road Car Park 125: 323 Richmond Street East Car Park 261: 45 Abell Street This initiative is part of the Toronto Parking Authority's ongoing commitment to deliver a superior customer experience in our parking facilities, emphasizing convenience, reliability, and operational excellence. Site selection was based on comprehensive signal strength assessments conducted in Q4 2024, which identified locations with average signal levels below -105 dBm, supplemented by customer…

The Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority: 1. Authorized the President, Toronto Parking Authority, to negotiate, enter and execute a contract with Rogers Communications Canada Inc., to deliver the Distributed Antenna System Cell Phone Repeater Project (RFP-ITDAS-202503-01), in an amount not exceeding $4,218,077.90, inclusive of contingency but excluding Harmonized Sales Tax.
